ceilingBasis.heavyValidation: 3 concurrent builds x 3 cargo jobs = 9 of 10 measured cores; overlap on the 10th is accepted so the scheduler is not idle on I/O waits
ceilingBasis.rustTestThreads: 4 per build matches the 10-core box without thrashing
ceilingBasis.agentCeiling: agents are network-bound, not CPU-bound; 96 is the dispatch ceiling, gated at runtime by authorized route concurrency and resident memory, never by this number alone

bottleneckPolicy.rule: A ceiling may only exist for a measured physical resource (cores, memory, disk, provider concurrency, evaluator independence). Any ceiling that exists only for coordination comfort must be raised to the measured limit or removed.
bottleneckPolicy.integrationWritersRationale: Multiple parallel integration lanes are authorized. Each lane owns a disjoint path set and serializes only its own fast-forward publish; canonical publication itself stays an ff-only, token-guarded, non-force operation.
bottleneckPolicy.candidateHighWaterRationale: No practical backpressure: a large ready queue is drained by the integration fleet, not throttled by a queue cap.
bottleneckPolicy.independentReviewIsNotABottleneck: Review separation (author != reviewer) is a correctness invariant, not a concurrency limit. It must still be honoured at any parallelism.

worktreeLifecycle.rule: A worktree or local branch may be deleted ONLY after BOTH: (1) its tip is an ancestor of the current main-v2, and (2) that tip is present on the push remote. Nothing is deleted on the strength of being 'probably merged'.
order: verify tip is ancestor of main-v2
verify tip exists on push remote (git ls-remote)
neverDelete: worktrees whose branch tip is absent from the push remote
dirty worktrees with uncommitted or untracked user work
